Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by (SDZ21) Maria Follower ((SDZ21) Maria Follower.esp).

Install this if (SDZ21) Maria Follower.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.
